bio: Regionality and sustainability are two principles that underpin Bavarie, here at BMW Welt. This translates into combining elements of Bavarian and French cuisine with a focus on high-quality produce. You can dine à la carte or take the set menu – there is also a vegan option, plus a three-course business lunch deal. The atmosphere in the spacious, airy, high-ceilinged room is pleasant. Nice terrace with a view of the Olympic Park and Tower....
